sections.changelog:
Added

  • Placeholder image is now picked in the UI: General tab → «Placeholder image» opens the WordPress media library, with a preview and a «Reset to default» button. No code needed to replace the image shipped with the plugin
  • Placeholder rendering moved to `mvweb_cp_get_placeholder_html()` — a picked image goes through `wp_get_attachment_image()`, so it gets `srcset`/`sizes` and honours the chosen image size; a deleted attachment silently falls back to the bundled SVG
  • `exclude` shortcode attribute: leave selected child pages out of a list by ID (`[mvweb-cp id="10" exclude="12,15"]`), passed straight to the native `exclude` argument of `get_pages()`
  • Help tab: FAQ entries on setting the manual page order, where a newly created page lands, and how to hide a single page; `exclude` added to the attributes table
  • General tab: hint under «Order by» explaining that Menu order comes from the page's own «Order» field

Changed

  • Menu order sorting: WordPress gives every new page `menu_order = 0`, so 0 is now read as «position not set» — those pages go after the numbered ones instead of jumping to the top, and are sorted by ID (creation order) among themselves
  • Menu order sorting: pages sharing the same `menu_order` now fall back to ID, so the order no longer depends on what MySQL happens to return
  • Updated the bundled `MVweb_Menu` shared class to v2.6.0 (catalog 2026.07.11, `-latest.zip` download URLs, Local Business and Object Map entries)
  • `admin.css` refreshed from the current boilerplate UI Kit (element resets scoped to `.mvweb-settings`/`.mvweb-ui` via `:where()`, `.mvweb-tab-content` rules, checkbox row alignment)

Fixed

  • `limit` is now applied after sorting: with a PHP-side sort (menu order, natural title order) the SQL `LIMIT` used to cut the wrong pages before they were reordered
  • Help tab: comments inside the CSS examples are now translatable, so the ru_RU screen no longer mixes Russian prose with English code comments
  • Settings page: the toggle in a form row is aligned with its label again (a 24px switch sat ~6px above the label text, which carries `padding-top: 9px` for input rows) — fixed in the shared UI Kit, so it applies to every plugin on the next refresh
